∀ {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (s : NKU.State),
  @Eq.{1} (NKU_Chronology.Run (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.{0, 0} NKU.Pair NID_ResumeEmission.verifier.Error))
    (@NKU_ParentFold.G H d hash s)
    (@NJU_ResumeObserved.run (NKU.Frame.reservation (NKU.State.frame s)) H d (NKU.Frame.checkpoint (NKU.State.frame s))
      (NKU.Frame.proof (NKU.State.frame s)) (NKU.Frame.publicBytes (NKU.State.frame s))
      NID_ResumeEmission.transport.Variant.S2 hash)

∀ {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (s : NKU.State),
  @Eq.{1}
    (Aeneas.Std.Result.{0}
      (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.{0, 0} (Prod.{0, 0} NIL_StatePort.C.P NIL_StatePort.C.A) NIL_Carriers.Cohort.Err))
    (NIL_StatePort.reply
      (@NJU_Log.Run.result NJU_ResumeObserved.Event
        (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.{0, 0} NKU.Pair NID_ResumeEmission.verifier.Error)
        (@NKU_ParentFold.G H d hash s)))
    (@AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps
      (AspisR1.CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops (NJC_FilledClause.reserved (NKU.Frame.reservation (NKU.State.frame s)))) H d
      (NKU.Frame.checkpoint (NKU.State.frame s)) (NKU.Frame.proof (NKU.State.frame s))
      (NKU.Frame.publicBytes (NKU.State.frame s)) AspisR1Stage2.transport.Variant.S2 hash)

∀ {H : Type} (d : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (s : NKU.State),
  @NKK_LogClauses.Holds NJU_ResumeObserved.Event
    (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.{0, 0} NKU.Pair NID_ResumeEmission.verifier.Error)
    (@NKK_Clauses.Clause (NKU.Frame.reservation (NKU.State.frame s)) H d hash) (@NKU_ParentFold.G H d hash s)
